question: Can a spatially coherent dense reference-transfer component localize a query-bounded endpoint mask on a fresh registered doorframe pair?

source_selector.candidate_order: provider OBB area descending, then scan IDs and instance ID

frame_rules.frame_ranking: visible vertices, visible ratio, projected area, image margin, then earlier frame

sam_masker.name: facebook/sam2.1-hiera-small
sam_masker.component_selection: within the correspondence-derived ROI, maximize positive-prompt hits, then area, then stable label
sam_masker.extent_decoder: convex hull of selected supported query-mask pixels after fixed ROI intersection
sam_masker.endpoint_decoder: actual selected-mask pixels with minimum and maximum projection on the supported-pixel principal axis

partial_reference.description: Positive reference support is restricted to the positive-edge quarter; the rest of the full doorframe is ignored.

complete_reference.description: Positive reference support covers the complete registered reference doorframe.

transfer_field.foreground_score: maximum cosine to arm-positive reference patches
transfer_field.background_score: maximum cosine to reference patches outside the complete target
transfer_field.active_rule: foreground score minus background score is at least zero
transfer_field.component_selection: connected component maximizing mutual-positive seed hits, then positive margin mass, area, and stable label
transfer_field.negative_prompt_source: inactive cells inside the expanded component ROI, ordered by background margin

allowed: reference RGB plus registered reference supervision
query_input_contract.note: Forbidden query fields remain evaluator-only and are read only after both RGB predictions are sealed in memory.

stop_rule: Freeze one source-distinct registered pair before reading RGB, run the spatially bounded decoder once, and do not tune the field, ROI, prompts, thresholds, models, frames, decoder, or gate after replay.
claim_boundary: One source-distinct real indoor 3RScan stable-doorframe Development canary. A pass would establish only that a spatially coherent reference transfer can seed a query-bounded learned RGB endpoint mask on one held-out rescan. It does not establish multi-scene generalization, exact physical identity under distractors, doorway aperture, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, product benefit, user benefit, or safety.
